name: io.github.Vaquill-AI/canlii-mcp
title: CanLII
description: MCP server for the CanLII Canadian legal information API. Provides case law and legislation metadata across all federal, provincial, and territorial Canadian jurisdictions. MIT-licensed. Bring-your-own CanLII API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token gating access to the hosted CanLII MCP endpoint. Format: 'Bearer <token>'.

headers.name: X-CanLII-Token
headers.description: Your CanLII API key. Apply for one at https://www.canlii.org/en/feedback/feedback.html. The server never stores your key.
